name: 18-stale-params
query: Write me a prompt for Claude to summarise customer support tickets, and tell me which model slug to set.

checks.what: says in one line that the model facts were last verified over 60 days ago, with the date
checks the model online with a web tool that succeeds, or tells the user the model details are unverified
checks.regex: (couldn.t|didn.t|could not|did not|wasn.t able to|unable to)\s+re-?check|unverified|not verified|could not (verify|confirm)|couldn.t (verify|confirm)|no official|haven.t verified|not been verified

checks.what: line after the block starts with 🎯 Target:
an API slug is stated and every slug appears in params.md
